title: Discrete Varying Delay
text: Discrete varying delay with support for fixed delay and zero delay (direct feedthrough), 2 inputs, 1 output, {Initial output} sets Initial output; {Nominal delay (number of samples)} sets the nominal value of delay, {Maximum delay} sets the maximum value of delay length input, {Fixed delays (indices)} sets the signal indices with fixed delays, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} and {Prevent direct feedthrough with minimum delay of 1}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Nominal delay (number of samples)
params.values: Nominal value of delay 1 (default) | nonnegative integer | vector of nonnegative integer values

params.name: Maximum delay
params.values: Maximum value of delay length input 10 (default) | nonnegative integer | vector of nonnegative integer values

params.name: Fixed delays (indices)
params.values: Signal indices with fixed delays [] (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Prevent direct feedthrough with minimum delay of 1
